name: Mount Monitor
author: jasonlnheath
description: A simple visualizer of disk usage that monitors when space gets too high. At 98% or more it throws a notification and glows red. Notifications are configured to go to your agent of choice with a skill that suggests files to prune / compress.

barWidget.description: Usage ring per btrfs mount; alerts at 80/90/98%; click a notification to have your agent run a cleanup analysis.
